import os
from pathlib import Path
programs=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790689809/attempts/82cd395e7c604aefb1723d109802e08f/system/state/workspace/programs')
programs.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source='''def transform(grid):
    n = len(grid)
    if not n:
        return []
    cw = [list(row) for row in zip(*grid[::-1])]
    ccw = [list(row) for row in zip(*grid)][::-1]
    half = [list(grid[i]) + cw[i] for i in range(n)]
    lower = [ccw[i] + list(grid[::-1][i][::-1]) for i in range(n)]
    return half + lower
'''
path=programs/'task-fc0debb4.py'
path.write_text(source)
exec(compile(source,str(path),'exec'),globals())
test=[[1,1],[1,1]]
result=transform(test)
print(result)
